blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.
blocks.zh: 光谱成像能捕捉到普通RGB传感器所不能得到的信息,但专用光谱相机可以昂贵而大宗. 从RGB图像中回收密集光谱提供了一个可访问的替代品,但有区别的光谱可以产生相同的相机响应,产生一个甚至更高级的恢复算法都无法总解决的模糊. 因此,增加获取时获取的光谱信息至关重要。 我们提议DualSpec,一种立体式的获取框架,它联合优化了两个外部光学过滤器和重建网络. 每个滤波器被放入一款标准的RGB相机前,两者被设计为产生为网络提供补充信息的6个响应. 跨越重建架构和光谱范围的实验显示,DualSpec相对于单个RGB相机将平均光谱角度误差减少36-72%,相对于从商业过滤器中选择的立体对则减少11-29%. 跨数据集评价,包括从分散的观点中获取的光谱图像的新基准,表明该方法一般化,而且仍然有力,可以看错对称,而薄膜近似分析则支持光学可行性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spectral imaging captures how light from a scene varies across wavelengths, preserving details that get lost when measurements are reduced to three RGB channels. This additional information supports applications in remote sensing, healthcare, industrial inspection, and computational photography [ 15 , 14 , 22 , 48 , 9 ] . Hyperspectral cameras measure spectra directly, but often rely on scanning mechanisms that acquire scenes sequentially, limiting their use in dynamic settings and requiring bulky optical and mechanical components. Snapshot systems avoid sequential capture by using filter arrays or coded optics, but can trade spatial resolution for spectral resolution or introduce more elaborate optics [ 29 , 47 ] . Overall, the cost and complexity of these specialized imaging systems remain significant barriers to their large-scale adoption. These limitations motivate spectral reconstruction from RGB images as a more accessible alternative for obtaining dense spectral information with widely available cameras.
blocks.zh: 光谱成像捕捉到场景的光线如何因波长而变化,保存在测量缩小为三个RGB通道时丢失的细节. 这一补充资料支持遥感、保健、工业检查和计算摄影方面的应用[15、14、22、48、9]。 超光谱摄像头直接测量光谱,但往往依赖于连续获取场景的扫描机制,限制其在动态环境中的使用,需要大量光学和机械组件. 快照系统通过使用滤波阵列或编码光学来避免顺序捕捉,但可以通过空间分辨率交换光谱分辨率或采用更复杂的光学[29,47]. 总体而言,这些专门成像系统的成本和复杂性仍然是大规模采用这些系统的重大障碍。 这些限制促使从RGB图像中进行光谱重建,作为利用广泛可用的相机获取密集光谱信息的更方便的替代品.

blocks.en: Recovering a spectrum from an RGB measurement is, however, fundamentally ill-posed because each RGB channel integrates the incident spectrum through a broad sensitivity function. In particular, metamerism occurs when distinct spectra produce identical RGB responses under the same imaging conditions. A learned reconstruction model can use statistical priors in natural scenes to predict a likely spectrum, but the RGB values alone cannot identify which of two metamers generated the measurement [ 12 ] . Figure 1 illustrates this ambiguity using real and artificial objects whose similar RGB appearances can make their distinct spectra difficult to tell apart in a single-camera reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 然而,从RGB测量中恢复一个频谱,从根本上说,这是不正确的,因为每个RGB信道都通过广泛的敏感功能来整合事件频谱. 特别是在不同的光谱在相同的成像条件下产生相同的RGB响应时,元化发生. 学习到的重建模型可以使用自然场景中的统计前科来预测一个可能的频谱,但光是RGB值无法确定两个元器件中哪一个生成了测量[12]. 图1用真实的和人造的物体来说明这种模糊性,这些物体的RGB相似的外观使其独特的光谱在单镜头重建中难以分辨.

blocks.en: Reducing this ambiguity requires additional, spectrally diverse measurements. Adding an external filter attachment for a single camera [ 31 , 53 ] can reshape its sensitivities, but three measurements per pixel remain subject to metameric ambiguity. Multi-camera systems instead capture the scene through several standard RGB cameras, each behind a different external optical filter. The filters give the views complementary spectral sensitivities, so that two cameras yield six measurements at each pixel and constrain the underlying spectrum more strongly than a single RGB triplet. Previous multi-camera approaches select these filters from commercial catalogs [ 38 , 36 ] . Such filters are readily available, but the catalog restricts the transmittances that can be combined. Moreover, because training a reconstruction network for every candidate pair is impractical, selection relies on proxy criteria, and the chosen pair may be suboptimal for the network that ultimately processes its measurements.
blocks.zh: 减少这种模糊性需要额外的、光谱多样的测量。 为单相机添加外部过滤附件[31,53]可以重塑其敏感性,但每个像素的三次测量仍然受到元模模糊的影响. 多相机系统转而通过几台标准的RGB相机捕捉场景,每台相机在不同的外部光学滤波器后面. 滤波器给出了视图互补的光谱敏感度,因此两个相机在每个像素上产生6个测量结果,并且比一个RGB三重机更强烈地约束了基础光谱. 以往的多相机方法从商业目录中选择这些过滤器[38,36]. 这种滤波器很容易获得,但目录限制了可以合并的传递. 此外,由于为每对候选者培训一个重建网络是不切实际的,因此选择依赖于代理标准,被选择的对子对于最终处理其测量的网络来说可能是次优的.

blocks.en: Rather than selecting filters from a fixed catalog, we design them together with the network that uses their measurements. We propose DualSpec, a stereo spectral reconstruction framework that jointly optimizes the transmittance of an external attachment for each RGB camera and the weights of the reconstruction network. A differentiable image-formation model propagates the reconstruction loss through both filtered views, allowing the attachments to develop complementary responses tailored to the network. The model accounts for light loss through each filter, so that optimization balances spectral selectivity against noise. To enforce physical manufacturability, we parameterize each transmittance with a Gaussian basis and a sigmoid, yielding smooth curves with values between zero and one.
blocks.zh: 而不是从一个固定的目录中选择过滤器, 我们设计它们与使用它们测量的网络。 我们提出DualSpec,一个立体光谱重建框架,它联合优化每个RGB相机的外部附件的传输以及重建网络的重量. 一个不同的图像造型模型通过两种过滤的视图传播重建损失,使附件能够针对网络开发补充性响应. 该模型计算每个过滤器的光损耗,从而优化平衡光谱选择性和噪音。 为了强化物理制造能力,我们用一个高斯基础和一个西格莫德参数化每个传输,产生平滑曲线,数值在0到1之间.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We introduce DualSpec, a stereo spectral acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two attachments and a spectral reconstruction network for standard RGB cameras. • We show consistent gains across backbones and spectral ranges over single-camera and commercial-filter stereo baselines. • We collect a displaced-view benchmark of spectral image pairs captured from different viewpoints, on which the learned designs transfer without fine-tuning. • We assess optical feasibility through multilayer thin-film approximations, showing that a short network fine-tuning on the fitted transmittances recovers the performance of the learned designs.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们引入了DualSpec,即一个立体光谱获取框架,它联合优化了两个附件和一个用于标准RGB相机的光谱重建网络. 我们显示在单摄像头和商用滤波器立体基线上,各骨干和光谱范围都取得了一致的收益。 我们收集了从不同角度采集到的光谱图像对的异视基准,所学到的设计在不作微调的情况下转移。 我们通过多层薄膜近似值来评估光学可行性,显示在安装的传输器上进行短网微调可恢复所学设计的效果.

blocks.en: We introduce DualSpec, a stereo spectral acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two attachments and a spectral reconstruction network for standard RGB cameras.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DualSpec,一个立体光谱获取框架,它联合优化了两个附件,并为标准RGB相机建立了光谱重建网络.

blocks.en: We show consistent gains across backbones and spectral ranges over single-camera and commercial-filter stereo baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们显示在单摄像头和商用滤波器立体基线上,各骨干和光谱范围之间持续的收益。

blocks.en: We collect a displaced-view benchmark of spectral image pairs captured from different viewpoints, on which the learned designs transfer without fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了从不同角度采集到的光谱图像对的异景基准,所学到的设计在不作微调的情况下转移。

blocks.en: We assess optical feasibility through multilayer thin-film approximations, showing that a short network fine-tuning on the fitted transmittances recovers the performance of the learned designs.
blocks.zh: 我们通过多层薄膜近似值来评估光学可行性,显示在安装的传输器上进行短网微调可恢复所学设计的效果.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Several acquisition designs have been proposed to capture dense spectral information, each introducing different trade-offs in acquisition speed, spatial resolution, hardware complexity, or operating conditions. Line-scan instruments and filter-wheel cameras provide finely sampled spectral measurements through sequential acquisition, but this increases capture time, sensitivity to scene motion, and optical–mechanical complexity [ 45 , 6 , 5 ] .
Snapshot multispectral filter-array systems capture all bands in a single exposure, but allocate different wavelengths to different pixels, producing a trade-off between spatial and spectral resolution [ 29 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh:
已提出若干项获取设计,以获取密集的光谱信息,每项设计均在获取速度、空间分辨率、硬件复杂性或操作条件方面引入不同的权衡。 线扫描仪器和滤波轮相机通过顺序获取提供了精细的光谱测量样本,但这增加了捕获时间、对场景运动的敏感性和光学-机械复杂性[45、6、5]。
快照多光谱滤波阵列系统在一次曝光中捕获所有波段,但将不同的波长分配到不同的像素上,产生空间分辨率和光谱分辨率之间的权衡[29,43].

blocks.en: Controlled-illumination methods efficiently acquire complementary spectral measurements through multiplexed lighting, rolling-shutter acquisition, or coded exposures [ 33 , 46 ] . However, their reliance on synchronized active lighting largely restricts their use to controlled indoor settings.
blocks.zh: 受控光学方法通过多轴照明、滚动-舒特获取或编码曝光有效获得补充光谱测量[33、46]。 然而,它们依赖于同步的主动照明,这在很大程度上限制了它们用于控制室内环境。

blocks.en: These approaches demonstrate different ways of acquiring informative spectral cues. However, their reliance on specialized sensors, optics, scanning mechanisms, or active illumination makes spectral imaging systems costly and limits their widespread adoption. We therefore target a more accessible stereo device that uses standard RGB cameras equipped with passive external attachments of different transmittances, providing a path toward low-cost snapshot spectral acquisition.
blocks.zh: 这些方法显示了获得信息光谱提示的不同方式。 然而,它们依赖专门传感器、光学、扫描机制或主动照明,使得光谱成像系统成本高昂,并限制了其广泛采用。 因此,我们的目标是一个更方便使用的立体装置,它使用配备有不同传输装置的被动外部附件的标准RGB摄像机,为低成本的快照光谱获取提供了一条道路。

blocks.en: Early RGB-to-spectrum methods operated independently on individual pixels, constraining the set of possible spectra using low-dimensional bases, regression, or sparse representations [ 34 , 30 , 1 ] . As larger datasets and public spectral-recovery challenges became available, research shifted toward deep convolutional neural networks that exploit spatial context [ 24 , 37 , 3 , 4 ] . Subsequent approaches incorporated attention layers, including spectral-wise attention and spatial–spectral attention mechanisms, to capture dependencies across spectral channels and spatial locations [ 8 , 49 , 51 ] . More recent work explores generative spectral priors to guide the recovery of spectral information from RGB observations [ 50 ] . Although this progression has substantially improved reconstruction accuracy, increasing model complexity or strengthening the learned prior does not increase the spectral information contained in the RGB input. Because distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, a reconstruction model can only use priors learned from the training distribution to select a likely solution and cannot uniquely distinguish metamers from the RGB measurements alone [ 12 , 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的RGB-对光谱方法在单个像素上独立运行,使用低维基,回归,或稀疏的表示[34,30,1]来约束一组可能的光谱. 随着更大的数据集和公共光谱恢复挑战的出现,研究转向利用空间背景的深层神经网络[24、37、3、4]。 随后的办法包括了注意层,包括光谱注意和空间-光谱注意机制,以捕捉跨光谱信道和空间位置的依赖性[8、49、51]。 更近期的工作探索了基因谱系前身,以指导从RGB观测中回收光谱信息[50]. 虽然这一进展大大提高了重建的准确性,但模型复杂性的提高或先前学到的加强并不能增加RGB输入中包含的光谱信息. 由于截然不同的光谱可以产生相同的相机响应,一个重建模型只能使用从训练分布中吸取的前科来选择一个可能的解决方案,并且不能单独将元器件与RGB测量结果区分开来[12,50].

blocks.en: Rather than introducing another reconstruction architecture, our approach increases the information available at acquisition through complementary optical measurements, revealing spectral differences that a single RGB observation might miss.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法不是引入另一个重建架构,而是通过补充光学测量来增加获取时可获得的信息,揭示出单个RGB观测可能错失的光谱差异.

blocks.en: Optical filtering modifies a camera’s effective spectral sensitivity without replacing its sensor. In camera color correction, chromagenic approaches optimize an external filter to improve the mapping from RGB measurements to device-independent color coordinates [ 10 ] . A similar strategy has been applied to spectral reconstruction by selecting an attachment from a bank of measured filters [ 2 ] . A suitable filter can make spectra that appear similar under the native camera sensitivities more distinguishable. However, a predetermined filter bank restricts the design space and makes reconstruction performance dependent on the available candidates. Recent methods expand this space by jointly adapting acquisition and reconstruction through selected or learned camera sensitivities, or optical attachments [ 13 , 31 , 42 , 53 ] . While these methods demonstrate the benefit of tailoring spectral responses to the reconstruction task, they either retain only three measurements from a single camera or require modifications to the sensor hardware.
blocks.zh: 光学过滤改变相机的有效光谱敏感度而不更换其传感器。 在相机色彩校正中,染色体方法优化了外部过滤器,以改善从RGB测量到设备独立色彩坐标的映射[10]. 在光谱重建中采用了类似的策略,从一个测量过滤器库中选择了附件[2]。 一个合适的滤波器可以使在原生相机敏感度下出现的类似光谱更能区分. 然而,预先确定的过滤库限制了设计空间,使重建业绩依赖于现有候选人。 最近的方法通过选定的或学到的相机敏感性或光学附件[13、31、42、53]联合调整获取和重建,扩大这一空间。 虽然这些方法表明对重建任务进行光谱响应的好处,但它们要么只保留了单一相机的3个测量值,要么需要对传感器硬件进行修改。

blocks.en:
Multi-camera approaches acquire additional spectral information by placing different filters in front of multiple RGB sensors. Shrestha et al . [ 38 ] select physically available filter pairs through exhaustive evaluation using shallow regression models.
Reutsky et al . [ 36 ] select filters for a multi-camera smartphone by minimizing spectral uncertainty and then learn reconstruction from the resulting misaligned views. In both cases, the filters are fixed before the network is trained and are drawn from a candidate bank. Exhaustive pairwise search also scales quadratically with the number of filters, which forces reliance on proxy criteria that may not align with final reconstruction performance. DualSpec instead learns the transmittances jointly with the network, allowing each to adapt to the other.
blocks.zh:
多相机方法通过在多个RGB传感器前放置不同的滤波器来获取额外的光谱信息. Shrestha等人. [38] 通过使用浅回归模型的详尽评估选择实际可用的滤镜对。
Reutsky et al. [36] 通过将光谱不确定性最小化,选择多相机智能手机的过滤器,然后从由此产生的错位视图中学习重建. 在这两种情况下,过滤器都是在培训网络之前固定的,并从候选银行抽取。 精练双智搜索也以过滤器的数量为四倍比例,这迫使依赖可能与最终重建性能不相符的代理标准. DualSpec转而与网络共同学习传输功能,使各自能够适应对方.

blocks.en: 3 DualSpec
blocks.zh: 3 双管

blocks.en: DualSpec increases the information available for spectral reconstruction by capturing a scene with two RGB cameras equipped with different passive optical attachments. We jointly learn the attachment transmittances and the reconstruction network so that the two cameras acquire complementary measurements tailored to spectral recovery.
blocks.zh: DualSpec通过捕捉配备有不同被动光学附件的两台RGB相机的场景,增加了可用于光谱重建的信息. 我们共同学习附件传送器和重建网络,以便两台摄像机获得适合光谱恢复的补充测量。

blocks.en: We select the sensor sensitivities according to the spectral range of each experiment. Visible-range experiments use measured sensitivities for a Sony IMX477 sensor [ 40 ] with its IR-cut filter. Because the available IMX477 measurements do not extend into the near-infrared, experiments covering 400–1000 nm use a sensitivity model for a Sony IMX224 sensor [ 39 ] without an IR-cut filter, which spans the full spectral interval.
blocks.zh: 我们根据每个实验的光谱范围来选择传感器的敏感度. 可见距离实验用测量的灵敏度用于具有IR剪切滤波器的Sony IMX477传感器[40]. 由于现有的IMX477测量不延伸至近红外线,覆盖400–1000纳米的实验使用一个SONY IMX224传感器的灵敏模型[39],没有IR剪切滤波器,它跨越整个光谱间隔.

blocks.en: We use capped auto-exposure to account for light lost through each attachment. We set the exposure of a reference unfiltered camera to collect a fixed mean number of photoelectrons in its green channel. Each filtered camera increases its exposure to match that mean, up to a factor of t max t_{\max} . If the exposure cap is reached before the target is met, the camera collects fewer photoelectrons and has a lower signal-to-noise ratio. We then add Poisson shot noise and Gaussian dark noise and quantize the resulting signal. Finally, we divide each channel’s values by its response to an equal-energy white spectrum to simulate digital gain.

blocks.en: 3.3 Two-stage optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 两级优化

blocks.en: Optimization proceeds in two stages. In the first stage, we jointly optimize the attachment coefficients and the network parameters 𝜽 \boldsymbol{\theta} through the acquisition model described in Section 3.1 . The shot noise is replaced by its Gaussian approximation, with variance equal to the collected charge, so that gradients of Eq. 2 propagate through noisy measurements and the attachments are optimized for the signal-to-noise ratio they actually produce.
blocks.zh: 优化分两个阶段进行. 在第一阶段,我们通过3.1节所述的获取模式,共同优化附件系数和网络参数。 镜头噪声被它的高斯近似化所取代,其差异等于收集的电荷,因此Eq. 2的梯度通过吵闹的测量来传播,附件被优化,以达到它们实际产生的信号对噪比.

blocks.en: In the second stage, we freeze the selected attachments and train the reconstruction network from scratch with the exact acquisition model, including Poisson shot noise, Gaussian dark noise, and quantization [ 3 ] . Separating the two stages avoids differentiating through Poisson sampling and lets the final network adapt to the noise statistics of the fixed optical design.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们冻结了选定的附件,并用精确的获取模型从零开始训练重建网络,包括波伊森射出的噪声,高斯暗噪声,以及量化[3]. 分离两个阶段避免通过普瓦森取样进行区分,让最终的网络适应固定光学设计的噪音统计.

blocks.en: The framework applies to any differentiable reconstruction network. We evaluate three representative families: a pixel-wise MLP, the convolutional EDSR [ 24 ] , and the attention-based MST++ [ 8 ] , representing per-pixel spectral mapping, spatial convolution, and spatial–spectral attention. Since only the input layer depends on the number of channels, DualSpec adds negligible inference cost over a single camera.
blocks.zh: 该框架适用于任何不同的重建网络。 我们评价三个具有代表性的家族:一个像素偏导的MLP,一个进化的EDSR [24],以及基于注意力的MST++ [8],代表着每像素光谱绘图,空间演化,以及空间-光谱注意力. 由于只有输入层取决于信道数量,DualSpec在单相机上增加了可忽略不计的推论成本.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: We use the Arad-1K dataset [ 4 ] as our primary visible-range benchmark. It features 950 publicly available natural scenes with a spatial resolution of 482 × 512 482\times 512 pixels and 31 bands spanning 400–700 nm. We divide them into training, validation, and test sets using an 80:10:10 split. For VNIR reconstruction, we use the 201 scenes of the BGU-ICVL dataset [ 1 ] . We resample cubes to 61 bands spanning 400–1000 nm and resize them to a width of 512 pixels. We reserve 20% of these scenes for testing and use 20% of the remaining scenes for validation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Arad-1K数据集[4]作为我们的主要可见距离基准. 它的特色是950个公开的自然场景,空间分辨率为482×512 482\times 512像素和31个横跨400~700nm的波段. 我们用80: 10: 10的分数把它们分为训练、验证和测试组。 对于VNIR重建,我们使用BGU-ICVL数据集的201场景[1]. 我们把立方体重新做成61个波段,宽度为400-1000纳米,并调整到512像素的宽度。 我们保留这些场景的20%用于测试,并使用其余的20%用于验证.

blocks.en: To evaluate cross-dataset generalization and robustness to viewpoint misalignment, we introduce a displaced-view benchmark containing ten pairs of spectral images independently captured from displaced viewpoints using a Specim IQ camera [ 41 ] . The benchmark comprises five staged indoor scenes and five outdoor scenes, spanning controlled compositions and natural environments. Further details about the acquisition setup and dataset composition are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 为了评价跨数据集的概括性和稳健性以看待错位,我们采用了一个失位视角基准,其中包含用Specim IQ相机从失位视角独立捕获的十对光谱图像[41]. 该基准包括5个分阶段室内场景和5个室外场景,涵盖受控制的组成和自然环境。 关于购置装置和数据集构成的进一步详情见补充材料。

blocks.en: We compare DualSpec with an unfiltered single RGB camera and a single-camera configuration with one learned attachment, following the joint optimization approach of Nie et al . [ 31 ] . For a fair comparison, the learned single attachment uses the same parameterization and acquisition model as DualSpec. For the stereo setting, we compare with adaptations of the filter-selection criteria proposed by Shrestha et al . [ 38 ] and Reutsky et al . [ 36 ] . To this end, we construct two candidate filter banks from manufacturer-published transmittance curves, comprising 210 responses collected from the Lee Filters catalog [ 21 ] and 136 from the Omega Optical catalog [ 32 ] . When forming candidate pairs, we also allow one camera to remain unfiltered, resulting in 22,155 candidate pairs for Lee and 9,316 for Omega Optical. Both selections use the same sensor as DualSpec. Once a pair is selected, its responses are fixed and the corresponding MLP, EDSR, or MST++ reconstructor is trained using the same protocol as the second stage of DualSpec. Additional details about catalog preparation and filter selection baselines are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们采用Nie等人的联合优化方法,将DualSpec与未过滤的单一RGB相机和单相机配置与一个学到的附加物进行比较。 [31]。 为了进行公平的比较,学到的单附件使用与DualSpec相同的参数化和获取模型. 就立体声设定而言,我们比较了Shrestha等人[38]和Reutsky等人[36]提出的过滤选择标准的修改。 为此,我们从制造商公布的传输曲线建造了两个候选过滤库,其中包括从Lee Filters目录中收集的210个答复和从Omega光学目录中收集的136个答复。 在形成候选配对时,我们也允许一台相机保持未过滤状态,结果李有22,155对候选配对,欧米茄光学9,316对. 两种选择都使用与DualSpec相同的传感器. 一对被选中后,其响应被固定,相应的MLP,EDSR,或MST++重建器使用与DualSpec第二阶段相同的协议进行训练. 补充材料中提供了关于编目和过滤器选择基线的其他细节。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the quantitative results on Arad-1K. A single learned attachment lowers mean SAM relative to unfiltered RGB for all three backbones, showing that reshaping the spectral sensitivities can make three measurements more informative. The complementary measurements provided by DualSpec yield a further gain. With the pixel-wise MLP, DualSpec reduces mean SAM to 4.73 ∘ 4.73^{\circ} , below both spatial backbones operating on unfiltered RGB ( 5.28 ∘ 5.28^{\circ} and 5.35 ∘ 5.35^{\circ} ). Because the MLP processes each pixel independently without relying on semantic cues, this improvement can be fully attributed to the additional information provided by DualSpec. EDSR and MST++ further reduce the error ( 2.02 ∘ 2.02^{\circ} and 1.93 ∘ 1.93^{\circ} against 4.73 ∘ 4.73^{\circ} ), which suggests that spatial context helps to resolve part of the remaining ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 表1显示Arad-1K的定量结果。 单个学习到的附着下层意味着SAM相对于所有三个主干线的未过滤RGB来说,显示重塑光谱敏感度可以使三个测量信息更加丰富. DualSpec提供的补充测量结果进一步增加。 以像素为主的MLP,DualSpec将SAM的平均值降低到4.73 ∘ 4.73 ^{\circ},低于在未过滤的RGB(5.28 ∘ 5.28 ^{\crc})和5.35 ∘ 5.35 ^{\crc}运行的空间主干线. 由于MLP在不依赖语义提示的情况下独立处理每个像素,这种改进可以完全归功于DualSpec提供的附加信息. EDSR和MST++进一步减少误差(2.02 ∘ 2.02 ^{\circ}和1.93 ∘ 1.93 ^{\crc}相对于4.73 ∘ 4.73 ^{\crc}),这表明空间背景有助于解决部分剩余的模糊性.

blocks.en:
All stereo configurations provide six input channels, so their differences reflect the design of the transmittances rather than the number of measurements. At this equal channel count, DualSpec lowers mean SAM by 11–15% relative to the best selected filter pair for each backbone. The gains extend to the median and tail statistics. For EDSR and MST++, the 95th-percentile SAM with DualSpec is even below the mean SAM of either single-camera configuration.
For filter selection baselines, results show that the best catalog depends on the considered backbone: under the Reutsky et al . criterion, Omega yields lower mean SAM for the MLP, while Lee does for EDSR and MST++. This further supports designing transmittances specifically for the network that will use them.

所有立体构型都提供了6个输入通道,因此它们的差异反映了传输的设计而不是测量的数量. 在这个相等的通道计数中, DualSpec 相对于每个主干线的最佳选择的滤镜对, SAM 下调 11–15% 。 收益扩大到中位数和尾数统计。 对于EDSR和MST++来说,带有DualSpec的第95百分位SAM甚至低于任何一个单相机配置的平均值SAM.
对于过滤器选择基线,结果显示最佳目录取决于考虑的骨干:在Reutsky et al.标准下,Omega对MLP的产量更低的平均值SAM,而Lee对EDSR和MST++. 这进一步支持专门为将使用它们的网络设计传送装置。

blocks.en:
Several applications require spectral information beyond the visible range [ 19 , 23 ] . We therefore evaluate DualSpec over 400–1000 nm, retraining both attachment transmittances and reconstruction networks for this wider interval on the BGU-ICVL dataset [ 1 ] . Commercial-filter stereo baselines are excluded because the available Lee and Omega filter data cover only the visible range.
Table 2 reports the VNIR reconstruction results. For the pixel-wise MLP, a single learned attachment brings mean SAM from 8.53 ∘ 8.53^{\circ} to 3.31 ∘ 3.31^{\circ} , showing that redistributing sensitivity across the wider band helps even with three channels. However, the optimized stereo pair cuts the remaining error by 29% and, as for the results on Arad-1K, it brings the pixel-wise model below both spatial models using unfiltered RGB in mean SAM.
The extra measurements also help models that already exploit spatial context. For EDSR and MST++, DualSpec reduces both mean SAM and its 95th percentile relative to either single-camera input.
The top panel of Figure 4 shows a qualitative example: the stereo input helps all three backbones recover the marked spectrum’s shape in both the visible and near-infrared ranges.

blocks.en:
We test whether the Arad-1K designs transfer when the two views come from different camera positions.
To this end, we employ the displaced-view benchmark described in Section 4.1 .
We synthesize RGB inputs from independently captured misaligned spectral cubes using the acquisition model described in Section 3.1 and apply the filters and networks optimized on Arad-1K without fine-tuning. For each stereo configuration, we estimate a homography from SIFT matches with RANSAC [ 26 , 11 ] . Single-camera methods use the right view alone, and all methods are evaluated over the same valid overlap.

我们测试Arad-1K设计在两种观点来自不同镜头位置时是否转移.
为此,我们采用第4.1节所述的流离失所观点基准。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows reconstruction accuracy on the registered displaced views. The single learned attachment, which helped on Arad-1K, raises mean SAM for both spatial backbones on these scenes. We attribute this to the ambiguity that remains with three channels, which the networks resolve with priors learned from the training scenes. The six complementary measurements of DualSpec reduce this reliance. The learned stereo pair also retains an advantage over the best selected stereo baselines for each backbone, lowering mean SAM by 12–22%, and its gains extend to the upper end of the error distribution. The bottom panel of Figure 4 shows a qualitative example on the displaced-view benchmark, where the error maps and plotted spectra confirm the gains across all backbones.

On the 32 scenes of CAVE [ 52 ] , evaluated in the same cross-dataset setting, DualSpec lowers mean SAM by 18–29% relative to the best selected pair (see supplementary material).
These results show that the acquisition gains persist also in cross-dataset evaluations and with real viewpoint misalignments.

Restricting the attachments to the spectral shapes of existing filters reduces accuracy: with EDSR and MST++, every Gaussian setting outperforms both catalog bases, and the Lee basis is the least accurate with every backbone. Within the Gaussian family, mean SAM varies by at most 0.22 ∘ , 0.11 ∘ , and 0.16 ∘ for the MLP, EDSR, and MST++, so the method is not sensitive to the exact choice of the basis. blocks.en:
After fabrication, the network can be fine-tuned on measured filter transmittances. Here, we fine-tune each network on the fitted thin-film transmittances for 60 epochs at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , starting from its original weights. As shown in Table 5 , with frozen weights, the fitted transmittances raise mean SAM by ∼ \sim 20% for EDSR and ∼ \sim 29% for MST++. With fine-tuning, all three networks outperform their best catalog pairs and come within 0.01 ∘ 0.01^{\circ} (EDSR and MST++) or 0.14 ∘ 0.14^{\circ} (MLP) of the mean SAM achieved with the optimized transmittances.
Together, these results show that the performance gains of DualSpec largely survive thin-film filter approximation, with a brief fine-tuning step recovering most of the loss.

制造后,网络可以在测量的滤波传输上进行微调. 这里,我们微调每个网络 在装配的薄膜 传输60个纪元, 学习率10 - 4 10 - 4 4}, 从最初的重量开始。 如表5所示,在有冷冻重量的情况下,安装的传输装置提高的SAM平均值为:EDSR为20%,MST++为29%。 通过微调,所有三个网络都超越了它们最好的目录对,并在0.01 + + + + (EDSR和MST++)或0.14 + 0.14 + + + Circ} (MLP) 内达到通过优化传输实现的中SAM.
这些结果加在一起表明DualSpec的性能增益基本上能维持薄膜滤波器近似,有一个短暂的微调步骤可以恢复大部分损失.

blocks.en: Our current design uses identical sensors to isolate the contribution of the learned attachments and simplify stereo acquisition. Employing different sensors could provide additional spectral diversity, but would require accounting for differences in quantum efficiency, exposure, synchronization, and field of view.
blocks.zh: 我们目前的设计使用相同的传感器来隔离所学附着物的贡献,简化立体获取. 使用不同的传感器可以增加光谱多样性,但需要考虑到量子效率、曝光、同步和视场等方面的差异。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented DualSpec, a stereo spectral-reconstruction framework that addresses the metameric ambiguity of RGB measurements by jointly optimizing two passive optical attachments and the reconstruction network. Across three reconstruction families and both visible and VNIR ranges, the complementary stereo measurements consistently reduce spectral error relative to single-camera acquisition and to stereo pairs selected from commercial filter banks. Cross-dataset evaluation on independently captured displaced views further demonstrates that the learned acquisition transfers without fine-tuning, while experiments on thin-film fits show that the designs can be manufactured with conventional multilayer coatings and recover the learned accuracy after brief fine-tuning. Overall, our results show that advancing spectral recovery is not only a matter of building more complex reconstruction models, but of designing measurements that make spectra distinguishable in the first place.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了DualSpec,这是一个立体光谱重建框架,通过联合优化两个被动光学附件和重建网络,解决RGB测量的元模糊问题。 在三个重建家族以及可见和VNIR范围中,补充的立体测量连续减少光谱误差,相对于单摄像头的获取和从商业过滤库中挑选的立体对。 对独立捕捉到的流离失所观点进行跨数据集评价进一步表明,所学得的获取转移没有微调,而薄膜试验则表明,这些设计可以用传统的多层涂层制造,并在短暂微调后恢复所学得的准确性。 总体而言,我们的结果表明,推进光谱恢复不仅是建立更复杂的重建模型的问题,而且是设计能够使光谱分辨性的测量方法的问题。

blocks.en:
We construct two banks from manufacturer-published visible-range transmittance curves. The Lee bank is derived from 219 lighting filters sampled from 405 to 700 nm at 5 nm intervals [ 21 ] . We remove nine diffusion filters because their spatial scattering cannot be represented by a scalar spectral transmittance, leaving 210 filters. The Omega Optical catalog is composed by interference and absorption-glass filters having sharper bandpass, longpass, shortpass, notch, and multiband responses [ 32 ] . Of 474 cataloged filters, 470 provide numerical curves. Curves expressed as optical density are converted using T ⁡ ( λ ) = 10 − OD ⁡ ( λ ) . T(\lambda)=10^{-\mathrm{OD}(\lambda)}. (S1) We retain filters whose measurements cover the full visible interval (400–700 nm) and reach at least 1% transmittance. We exclude mirrors, uncoated blanks, duplicated curves, and filters characterized at nonzero incidence angles. This yields 136 Omega filters. Figure S2 shows representative responses from both resulting filter banks.
Curves are converted to the 31 spectral bands of the visible-range experiments (400–700 nm) by linear interpolation and averaging over each 10 nm band.

blocks.en: We adapt the exhaustive stereo-filter search of Shrestha et al . [ 38 ] to two identical RGB cameras. We screen each filter independently, requiring its largest channel transmission factor to be at least 40% and every channel transmission factor to be at least 10% of that maximum. We evaluate all feasible pairs, including pairs with an unfiltered response. For each pair, we add Gaussian noise with a standard deviation of 2% of the signal, normalize the six responses by the pair’s largest white response, and quantize them to 12 bits.

blocks.en:
We follow Reutsky et al . ’s prior construction by subsampling images with a 29-pixel stride and clustering the resulting spectra into 1,024 groups using k k -means. Our prior uses 232,254 spectra from the Arad-1K training split [ 4 ] , with each cluster center weighted by the fraction of spectra assigned to it. We simulate the six-channel measurements using the camera model described in the main manuscript.
Our setup involves two identical cameras, therefore we evaluate unordered filter pairs.

我们的设定涉及两个相同的摄像头, 因此我们评估无序的过滤对。

blocks.en:
We estimate Eq. ( S3 ) in three Monte Carlo stages, using the same random draws for all pairs within each stage. We score all pairs with 4,096 samples, rescore the top 2,000 with 65,536 samples, and rescore the top 50 from that stage with 2 20 2^{20} samples.
The lowest-scoring pairs in the LEE and Omega catalogs are LEE 777 Rust with 798 Chrysalis Pink and Omega 435-600 DBEM with 496BP22 (1.25-inch NPB), respectively.
blocks.zh:
我们估计Eq.(S3)分为三个蒙特卡洛阶段,每个阶段的所有对子都使用相同的随机抽取. 我们以4,096个样本获得所有对数,以65,536个样本获得前2000个样本的复分,以前50个样本获得前20个样本的复分。

blocks.en: D Displaced-View Benchmark
blocks.zh: D 流离失所者-选民基准

blocks.en:
We acquired ten pairs of spectral images using a Specim IQ hyperspectral camera [ 41 ] . The camera was mounted on a bracket that allowed it to slide horizontally by a fixed displacement. For every pair, two independent acquisitions were made with a 2 cm baseline between viewpoints, which is representative of close-range commercial stereo geometries [ 27 ] .
The benchmark contains five staged indoor scenes and five outdoor scenes. Figure S7 shows both acquired views for all ten scenes.
The indoor subset includes color targets, fruit, paintings, plants, and arrangements of everyday objects. The outdoor subset includes vegetation, signs, brickwork, painted surfaces, and other textured structures.
blocks.zh:
我们用Specim IQ超光谱相机获得了十对光谱影像 [41]. 摄像机安装在一个括号上,使其能通过固定的置换水平滑动。 每对都进行了两次独立的收购,在视线之间的基线为2厘米,这代表了近距离商业立体几何[27].
基准包含5个舞台室内场景和5个室外场景. 图S7显示所有十个场景的既得视图。
室内子集包括色彩目标,水果,绘画,植物,以及日常物品的安排. 户外子集包括植被,标志,砖砌,涂装的表面,以及其他纹理结构.

blocks.en: To measure how much accuracy the misalignment between the views costs, we repeat the evaluation with both cameras acquiring the reference view, so that the stereo input has no displacement and requires no registration, with the same noise model and evaluation regions. Tables S3 and S4 report the complete results with the left and right views as the reference. Without misalignment, DualSpec remains the most accurate method with every backbone and both reference views (4.94–4.97 ∘ , 3.00–3.01 ∘ , and 2.85 ∘ mean SAM with the MLP, EDSR, and MST++), and obtains the best value of every statistic, except for the median PSNR with EDSR and the left reference, where the Reutsky Omega {}^{\text{Omega}} pair is marginally better (37.25 against 37.24 dB median PSNR).
blocks.zh: 为了衡量观测成本之间错位的准确度,我们用两台摄像头获得参考视图来重复评估,这样立体输入就不会被置换,不需要注册,同时使用相同的噪声模型和评价区域. 表S3和S4以左右视图作为参考,报告全部结果。 DualSpec没有错配,仍然是每个主干线和参考视图中最准确的方法(4.94–4.97 ∘,3.00–3.01 ∘,和2.85 ∘,与 MLP, EDSR,和 MST++),并获得每个统计的最佳值,但带有EDSR的PSNR中位数和左位参考值除外,其中Reutsky Omega {}^{\ text{Omega}} }}  pair  pair  pair  pair  pair,略好(37.25对 37.24 dB中位数 PSNR).

blocks.en: Removing the misalignment reduces the mean SAM of every stereo method, except for the Reutsky Lee {}^{\text{Lee}} pair with the MLP and the right reference, which is unchanged: by 4–6% with the MLP and 17–19% with EDSR and MST++ for DualSpec, and by up to 44% for the selected commercial pairs, the largest reductions being those of the Shrestha pairs with EDSR and MST++ (27–44%).

blocks.en: E Cross-Dataset Evaluation on CAVE
blocks.zh: E 现金收入跨数据集评价

blocks.en: The CAVE dataset [ 52 ] contains 32 indoor scenes of objects photographed in front of a dark background, which we use as a cross-dataset benchmark (see also Figure 1 of the main manuscript): the attachments and networks trained on Arad-1K are applied without fine-tuning, with the acquisition model and noise of the main experiments. The background is black cloth whose reflectance is close to zero and covers 41% of the pixels on average. There, the measured spectrum is dominated by the noise of the original acquisition, and the spectral angle, which is undefined for a zero spectrum, becomes unreliable for every method: the background pixels have a mean SAM of 16–41 ∘ depending on the configuration, against 6–14 ∘ on the objects, and would dominate the image-level metrics. We therefore evaluate on the object pixels only, using segmentation masks of the objects of each scene. Metrics are computed per image over these pixels and then averaged over the 32 scenes, as for the other datasets.
blocks.zh: CAVE数据集[52]包含32个在黑暗背景前拍摄的物体的室内场景,我们以此为跨数据集基准(另见主手稿图1):Arad-1K上训练的附属物和网络在应用时没有微调,主要实验的获取模型和噪音. 背景为黑色布,其反射率接近零,平均覆盖41%的像素. 在那里,测量的频谱以原始获取的噪音为主,未定义为零频谱的光谱角度变得不可靠,对每一种方法来说都是:背景像素的SAM平均值为16–41 ,取决于配置,相对于对象的6–14∘,将主导图像级的度量. 因此,我们只评估物体像素,使用每个场景物体的分解口罩。 度量衡按这些像素的每个图像计算,然后与其他数据集一样,平均计算32场景。

blocks.en: Table S5 reports the results. DualSpec achieves the best value of every statistic with every backbone, reducing mean SAM by 32%, 56%, and 56% relative to single RGB for the MLP, EDSR, and MST++, and by 18%, 29%, and 26% relative to the best selected pair. Taken together, the results on CAVE and the displaced-view benchmark show that DualSpec retains its reconstruction advantage on datasets unseen during training. Figure S8 shows qualitative results in which the marked pixel is chosen within the objects.

blocks.en: F Additional Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: F 其他定性结果

blocks.en: We show additional qualitative comparisons on Arad-1K, BGU-ICVL, and the displaced-view benchmark. Following the visualization protocol of the main manuscript, each figure shows spatial RMSE maps and reconstructed spectra at a marked pixel for all three backbones. In three visible-range Arad-1K scenes ( Figure S9 ), the complementary measurements reduce reconstruction error and yield spectra closer to the reference, particularly for EDSR and MST++. The three BGU-ICVL examples ( Figure S10 ) show improvements across the 400–1000 nm range, including for the pixel-wise MLP, which reconstructs each spectrum without using neighboring pixels. In three independently acquired displaced-view pairs ( Figure S11 ), the gains persist after registration in indoor and outdoor scenes with varying depth and texture.
blocks.zh: 我们对Arad-1K、BGU-ICVL和流离失所观点基准进行了更多的质量比较。 在主手稿的可视化协议之后,每个图都显示空间RMSE地图,并在标记的像素上重建所有三个主干线的光谱. 在三个可见距离的阿拉德-1K场景(图S9)中,互补测量会减少重建错误,并产生更接近参考的光谱,特别是EDSR和MST++. BGU-ICVL的三个例子(图S10)显示了400–1000nm范围内的改进,包括像素型的MLP,它重建每个频谱时不使用相邻的像素. 在独立获得的三对流离失所景物(图S11)中,在室内和室外景物登记后,其收益仍维持在不同深度和纹理上。

blocks.en: Figure S9 : Additional qualitative results on three extra Arad-1K test scenes. Spatial RMSE maps and spectra at the marked pixels compare single RGB, two Lee-bank stereo baselines, and DualSpec over 400–700 nm for all three backbones.
blocks.zh: 图S9:新增三个Arad-1K试验场景的定性结果. 标记像素上的空间 RMSE地图和光谱比较了单RGB,两个李岸立体基线,所有三个骨干都比DualSpec超过400–700nm.

blocks.en: Figure S10 : Additional qualitative results on three extra BGU-ICVL test scenes. Spatial RMSE maps and spectra at the marked pixels compare single RGB with DualSpec over 400–1000 nm for all three backbones.
blocks.zh: 图S10:增加三个BGU-ICVL测试场景的附加质量结果. 标记像素上的空间RMSE地图和光谱将单RGB和DualSpec比对所有三个骨干400–1000nm.

blocks.en: Figure S11 : Additional qualitative results on three extra scenes of our displaced-view benchmark. Over the registered common region, spatial RMSE maps and spectra at the marked pixels compare single RGB, two Lee-bank stereo baselines, and DualSpec for all three backbones.
blocks.zh: 图S11:我们流离失所观点基准的另外三个场景的其他质量结果。 在注册共同区域上,空间RMSE地图和标定像素的光谱比较了单RGB,两个李岸立体基线,以及所有三个主干线的DualSpec.
